spec.description: Frame time and memory of each basemap, one panel at a time. Needs the grafana.geomapProtomapsBasemap feature flag and a Protomaps tile server on localhost:8095. Rows are collapsed so only the row under test renders; open one panel at a time with viewPanel for single-panel runs. Data layers use 10,000-point TestData random walks around each view, enough to spot large regressions but too small for benchmark numbers.
